en.text: Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.

zhSimplified.text: 眷顾贫穷的有福了！ 他遭难的日子，耶和华必搭救他。

zhTraditional.text: 眷顧貧窮的有福了！ 他遭難的日子，耶和華必搭救他。

en.text: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必保全他，使他存活； 他必在地上享福。 求你不要把他交给仇敌，遂其所愿。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必保全他，使他存活； 他必在地上享福。 求你不要把他交給仇敵，遂其所願。

en.text: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

zhSimplified.text: 他病重在榻，耶和华必扶持他； 他在病中，你必给他铺床。

zhTraditional.text: 他病重在榻，耶和華必扶持他； 他在病中，你必給他鋪床。

en.text: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

zhSimplified.text: 我曾说：耶和华啊，求你怜恤我，医治我！ 因为我得罪了你。

zhTraditional.text: 我曾說：耶和華啊，求你憐恤我，醫治我！ 因為我得罪了你。

en.text: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

zhSimplified.text: 我的仇敌用恶言议论我说： 他几时死，他的名才灭亡呢？

zhTraditional.text: 我的仇敵用惡言議論我說： 他幾時死，他的名才滅亡呢？

en.text: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

zhSimplified.text: 他来看我就说假话； 他心存奸恶，走到外边才说出来。

zhTraditional.text: 他來看我就說假話； 他心存奸惡，走到外邊才說出來。

en.text: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

zhSimplified.text: 一切恨我的，都交头接耳地议论我； 他们设计要害我。

zhTraditional.text: 一切恨我的，都交頭接耳地議論我； 他們設計要害我。

en.text: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

zhSimplified.text: 他们说：有怪病贴在他身上； 他已躺卧，必不能再起来。

zhTraditional.text: 他們說：有怪病貼在他身上； 他已躺臥，必不能再起來。

en.text: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

zhSimplified.text: 连我知己的朋友， 我所倚靠、吃过我饭的也用脚踢我。

zhTraditional.text: 連我知己的朋友， 我所倚靠、吃過我飯的也用腳踢我。

en.text: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你怜恤我， 使我起来，好报复他们！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你憐恤我， 使我起來，好報復他們！

en.text: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

zhSimplified.text: 因我的仇敌不得向我夸胜， 我从此便知道你喜爱我。

zhTraditional.text: 因我的仇敵不得向我誇勝， 我從此便知道你喜愛我。

en.text: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

zhSimplified.text: 你因我纯正就扶持我， 使我永远站在你的面前。

zhTraditional.text: 你因我純正就扶持我， 使我永遠站在你的面前。

en.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—以色列的 神是应当称颂的， 从亘古直到永远。阿们！阿们！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－以色列的上帝是應當稱頌的， 從亙古直到永遠。阿們！阿們！
